Manifest.Name: Tuck
Manifest.Author: Mick van Gelderen
Manifest.Description:
Love Probably Stolen, but tired of the repetitive clicking? Give your hands a break with Tuck, your one-stop quality-of-life mod.
Pack your loot, move items in bulk, appraise goods, and run the chem finisher with fewer clicks and less fuss. You've got a shop to run.
Named after Tuck, the helpful rat who fits more loot into your bags. Small paws, big ambitions.Quality of life mod for night activity packing, keybindings, and more!
